description: This PHP class 'AuthCodeRepository' implements the OAuth2 AuthCodeRepositoryInterface, providing methods for managing OAuth2 authorization codes, such as persisting, revoking, and checking revocation status, though most methods throw a NotImplementedException.

classes.name: AuthCodeRepository
classes.description: A PHP class implementing OAuth2 AuthCodeRepositoryInterface, responsible for handling OAuth2 authorization code operations, though most methods are placeholders throwing exceptions.

methods.name: persistNewAuthCode
methods.description: Attempts to store a new authorization code but currently throws NotImplementedException.

methods.name: revokeAuthCode
methods.description: Marks an authorization code as revoked; currently throws NotImplementedException.

methods.name: isAuthCodeRevoked
methods.description: Checks if an auth code is revoked; currently always returns true.

methods.name: getNewAuthCode
methods.description: Returns a new instance of AuthCodeEntity.
